note: [LLM critic, high conf] The AI sends its 270 point Allarus unit on a 17% charge at a 4 wound Mek. The roll almost always fails, and a failed charge wastes the unit's turn. Fix: Multiply all positive charge rewards (damage, can_wipe, can_halve, character, target value) by the charge probability. Add a hard floor, for example no charge below 25% unless the target is a key objective holder. Count the opportunity cost of not moving or shooting, and the exposure to nearby enemy melee units.
suggestion: Allarus Custodians declares charge against Mek Beta (17% chance, 9.9" away, expected 13.3 melee dmg vs 4 HP, overwatch risk: 7.2 dmg)
